item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 01:40 PM 12 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(SanFernando, Cabanglasan, ManoloFortich, Sumilao, ImpasugOng, Kalilangan, Talakag), #DavaoDeOro(Laak, Monkayo, Montevista), #DavaoDelNorte(SanIsidro, Talaingod, Asuncion), #AgusanDelSur(LaPaz, SantaJosefa, Trento, Rosario), #TawiTawi(Sibutu, Sitangkai), #LanaoDelSur(Maguing and Bumbaran) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(Loreto, Bunawan, Veruela), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong), #TawiTawi(Mapun and TurtleIslands) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
